name: 盐雾（试验/等级/标准）评估

map.输入盐雾试验参数与腐蚀检测结果，依据GB/T 6461/ISO 4628/AST: Input salt-spray test parameters and corrosion findings to automatically determine the corrosion grade and pass/fail per GB/T 6461 / ISO 4628 / ASTM B117.
map.Rp₀ 按腐蚀面积分级（GB/T 6461）：0%→Rp10，≤0.1%→Rp8: Rp0 is graded by corroded area (GB/T 6461): 0%->Rp10, <=0.1%->Rp8, <=1%->Rp5, <=8%->Rp3, >25%->Rp0; final Rp = max(Rp0 - 0.5 x rust count - 0.3 x blister count - 0.5 x crack count - red-rust penalty 2, 0).
map.试验时长 ≥ 标准时长、无红锈、且最终评级 ≥ 要求等级时判定合格。Rp 越高耐: Pass when test duration >= standard duration, no red rust, and final grade >= required grade. Higher Rp means better corrosion resistance: >=9 excellent, >=8 very good, >=7 good; Rp together with blister/crack/rust grades determines the final conclusion.
map.NSS试验：5%NaCl溶液，pH 6.5-7.2，35℃: NSS test: 5% NaCl solution, pH 6.5-7.2, 35 C
map.ASS试验：加醋酸调pH 3.1-3.3，35℃，加速腐蚀: ASS test: add acetic acid to pH 3.1-3.3, 35 C, accelerated corrosion
map.CASS试验：加CuCl₂，50℃，pH 3.1-3.3，加速腐蚀: CASS test: add CuCl2, 50 C, pH 3.1-3.3, accelerated corrosion
map.白锈=镀层腐蚀（可接受），红锈=基体腐蚀（不合格）: White rust = coating corrosion (acceptable), red rust = substrate corrosion (fail)
map.按盐雾试验时长与腐蚀面积评定镀层/涂层耐蚀等级。: Rate the corrosion resistance of coatings/platings by salt-spray duration and corroded area.
map.对照 GB/T 6461 等标准判定是否合格。: Judge pass/fail against standards such as GB/T 6461.
map.比选表面处理工艺的耐蚀性。: Compare corrosion resistance of surface-treatment processes.
map.中性盐雾 240h 无红锈: Neutral salt spray 240h with no red rust
map.腐蚀面积接近 0 且无红锈，Rp 评级达 9 级以上，可满足一般户外环境使用要求: Corroded area near 0 and no red rust, Rp grade above 9, meets general outdoor-environment requirements.
map.红锈表明基体已腐蚀，无论 Rp 高低均判不合格，需改进镀层致密度或增厚。: Red rust indicates substrate corrosion; regardless of Rp it fails, so coating density or thickness must be improved.
map.NSS、ASS、CASS 有何区别？: What is the difference between NSS, ASS and CASS?
map.NSS 为中性盐雾，ASS 为醋酸盐雾（更苛刻），CASS 为铜加速醋酸盐雾（最: NSS is neutral salt spray, ASS is acetic-acid salt spray (harsher), CASS is copper-accelerated acetic-acid salt spray (fastest and harshest).
map.盐雾时长越长越好吗？: Is a longer salt-spray duration always better?
map.时长需与实际使用环境匹配，盲目延时会增加成本；应结合产品标准确定验收时长。: Duration must match the real service environment; blind extension raises cost; set acceptance duration per the product standard.
map.盐雾试验结果评估工具，支持NSS/ASS/CASS三种盐雾试验类型，依据GB/T: Salt-spray test result evaluation tool supporting NSS/ASS/CASS types; per GB/T 6461 and ISO 4628 it comprehensively rates defects such as corroded area, blistering, rust and cracking, automatically judging Rp corrosion grade and pass/fail and giving improvement suggestions.
